$$
F(x)=\{\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}-4, & x\in [-5,0] \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡x, & x\in (0,5)\end{aligned}
$$

Consider the function $F(x)$ shown above. Find the value to which the Fourier series of the $10$-periodic extension $f(x)$ of $F(x)$ is converging when $x=-3.$

The Fourier series converges to {{field-1}} when $x=-3.$
